services.title: Mobile app
services.content:
A few days ago, I had an interesting discussion with a friend about the direction of mobile development:
Where is mobile development heading — Native, Flutter, or React Native?
We had different opinions, so I decided to go beyond opinions and look at benchmarks and developer surveys from 2017 to 2026.
Looking across data from Stack Overflow Developer Surveys, JetBrains Developer Ecosystem, Statista, Google/Flutter reports, and historical adoption trends, the direction is interesting:
📉 Native remains essential, especially for performance and deep platform integration, but its relative dominance is being challenged by cross-platform development.
📈 Flutter has shown significant growth since its introduction, becoming one of the leading cross-platform technologies.
⚛️ React Native remains a major player with a mature ecosystem and strong adoption.
